description: Release travelers and work instructions through MES; send NC programs to 64 CNC machines through DNC; machine structural fittings, manifolds, and valve bodies
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $528,000 of Plant 1 shipments per production day; prime on-time delivery ratings; loaded jobs keep running for about one shift; a lost or altered NC program can crash a machine
manual_workaround: Printed job packets from controlled copies; machines finish loaded jobs; defer new setups; paper travelers entered later
dependent_people_or_facilities: Machine operators; Manufacturing Systems Manager; Plant 1 shop floor
quantified_operational_impact: 64 CNC machines and about 1,100 machine-hours a day; one day down defers about $528,000 of shipments, about 90% recovered with overtime within 3 weeks
quantified_regulatory_impact: None directly; late deliveries lower prime supplier ratings that feed award decisions
product_safety_impact: Moderate: a wrong NC program revision can damage a machine or produce a nonconforming flight part
contract_and_dfars_linkage: Prime A, Prime B, and Prime C delivery schedules

description: Sheet-metal forming, subassembly, fastener installation with machine-vision inspection (AI-002), and metal additive builds; legacy MES and DNC; 8 CNC machines loaded by USB drive
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $392,000 of Plant 2 shipments per production day; additive builds run 20 to 60 hours and a lost build file restarts the build; flat network means one infection can stop the whole plant
manual_workaround: Paper travelers; run proven programs already on machine controllers; finish builds in progress; move urgent machined work to Plant 1 where programs exist
dependent_third_parties: Additive printer vendor; machine tool vendors
dependent_people_or_facilities: Plant 2 operators; manufacturing systems engineer at Plant 2; Plant 2 shop floor
quantified_operational_impact: 26 CNC machines, 6 additive printers, and 2 assembly lines; one day down defers about $392,000; an interrupted additive build loses up to 60 machine-hours
product_safety_impact: Moderate: an assembly released without valid inspection records could reach an aircraft
contract_and_dfars_linkage: Prime A and Prime C assemblies; Customer D additive brackets

description: First article inspection; CMM and in-process inspection; certificates of conformance; nonconformance records; machine-vision results
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Parts cannot ship without inspection records; an inspection record error could let a nonconforming flight part reach an aircraft; AS9100 and prime quality clauses require records
manual_workaround: Hand gauges for simple features with paper reports; hold shipments that need CMM data; 100% manual inspection on the machine-vision line
dependent_systems: SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-07 (CMMs, vision cell)
dependent_people_or_facilities: 75 quality staff; inspection rooms at both plants
quantified_operational_impact: 12 CMMs; about 400 inspection reports a day; manual inspection takes about 3 times longer
quantified_regulatory_impact: Prime quality clauses require retrievable records; missing records cause escapes and corrective action requests
product_safety_impact: Severe: a nonconforming flight part could reach an aircraft
contract_and_dfars_linkage: Prime and Customer D quality clauses

description: Acceptance testing of manifolds and valve bodies on 6 test stands; test data acquisition and test reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Parts wait for test but can queue for a few days; test data integrity is critical because results prove acceptance
manual_workaround: Queue untested parts; manual data capture on paper for the 2 stands with standalone gauges
dependent_systems: SYS-07 (test stands); SYS-03 test data repository; SYS-05
dependent_people_or_facilities: 12 test engineers and technicians; test lab
quantified_operational_impact: About 60 hydraulic parts tested a day; 3 days down creates a backlog of about 180 parts
quantified_regulatory_impact: Prime acceptance test procedures are CUI and must be followed exactly
product_safety_impact: Severe if test data were altered; Moderate for an outage

description: Receive customer models; create and revise drawings; release engineering changes in PLM
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Released jobs keep running; new orders and changes wait; customer change deadlines are usually measured in days
manual_workaround: Work locally on CAD workstations and check in after recovery; no new revisions released until PLM returns
quantified_operational_impact: About 45 engineering changes a week; 3 days down delays about 27 changes
product_safety_impact: Minimal for an outage; an altered drawing would be Severe (integrity)

description: Create and prove NC programs and additive build files; write work instructions; plan routings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New setups need released NC programs; about 8 new part numbers start each week; a wrong program revision is a safety and quality risk
manual_workaround: Run proven programs already in DNC; postpone new part introductions
dependent_people_or_facilities: 32 manufacturing engineers and NC programmers; 8 additive engineers
quantified_operational_impact: About 8 new part introductions a week delayed
product_safety_impact: Moderate: a wrong program revision can damage a machine or produce nonconforming parts

business_process: CUI exchange with primes, customers, and suppliers
description: Download drawings from the Prime A portal; exchange files over the MFT gateway with Prime B, Prime C, services customers, and 22 suppliers; CUI email
process_owner: Director of Trade Compliance and Contracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New orders and changes arrive through these paths; outside processors need drawings with parts; senders keep copies and can re-send
manual_workaround: Prime A portal from any enclave laptop; controlled paper copies travel with parts to outside processors; partners re-send files
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-03 (virtual desktops, MFT); SYS-12; SYS-01
dependent_third_parties: Prime A portal; Prime B; Prime C; 22 suppliers
quantified_operational_impact: About 350 files exchanged a day across 25 partners
quantified_regulatory_impact: Export review is required before any new recipient gets technical data
contract_and_dfars_linkage: DFARS 252.204-7012(m) flowdown governs every supplier that receives CUI

business_process: Additive and engineering services for commercial customers
description: Receive customer CAD and build files through the MFT; prepare builds; print and finish parts; return build packages and reports
process_owner: Director of Additive and Engineering Services
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $40,000 of services revenue per production day; customer agreements commit to turnaround times and to protecting customer files (SOC 2 Availability and Confidentiality, P09)
manual_workaround: Notify customers; extend turnaround; prioritize builds already on printers
dependent_systems: SYS-03 (build preparation server, MFT); SYS-04; SYS-07 (additive printers)
dependent_third_parties: Three services customers; additive printer vendor
quantified_operational_impact: About 30 jobs a month; 2 days down delays about 3 jobs and triggers service credits
quantified_regulatory_impact: Customer agreements include confidentiality and turnaround terms (contractual)
contract_and_dfars_linkage: Services agreements require a SOC 2 Type 2 report by 2027-12-31

description: Enter customer orders; plan capacity; release work orders to MES; buy material and outside processing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Work order release and purchases stop; late material orders delay the schedule by the supplier lead time
manual_workaround: Printed open-order, schedule, and inventory reports (run weekly); phone and email purchase orders logged for later entry
quantified_operational_impact: About 120 purchase orders and 200 work orders a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: FCI in ERP is covered by FAR 52.204-21

description: Receive material; pack and ship finished parts with certificates of conformance; invoice
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Revenue is recognized at shipment (about $960,000 per production day); prime delivery ratings affect future awards
manual_workaround: Hand-written packing slips and certificates signed by Quality; invoice after ERP returns
dependent_people_or_facilities: Shipping and receiving staff; docks at both plants
quantified_operational_impact: About 260 shipments a day; 2 days down defers about $1.92 million of shipments

description: Send parts and drawings to outside processors (plating, heat treat, NDT, coatings, castings); supplier onboarding and flowdown
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Outside processing adds days to lead time; a 3-day stop delays parts already scheduled
manual_workaround: Controlled paper drawings travel with parts; phone confirmations
quantified_operational_impact: About 140 outside processing lots a week
quantified_regulatory_impact: No CUI to a supplier without DFARS 252.204-7012 flowdown (252.204-7012(m)(1))

business_process: Contracts, trade compliance, and DoD incident reporting
description: Review flowdowns; manage export authorizations; post SPRS scores; report cyber incidents to DoD through DIBNet and notify primes
process_owner: Director of Trade Compliance and Contracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: DFARS 252.204-7012(c) requires a report within 72 hours of discovery even while systems are down; ITAR releases need export review before data leaves
manual_workaround: Report from a clean corporate laptop with a medium assurance certificate; phone the primes' security contacts; paper export log
dependent_people_or_facilities: Director of Trade Compliance and Contracts; Security Manager
quantified_operational_impact: Small team; work stops only if the clean reporting endpoint and certificates are lost
quantified_regulatory_impact: Missed 72-hour report breaches DFARS 252.204-7012(c); unauthorized ITAR release (22 CFR 120.56)

business_process: Program management and customer quality reporting
description: Prime quality portals, delivery metrics, corrective action responses, and customer reviews
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Prime corrective action responses have deadlines measured in days
manual_workaround: Ask primes for extensions; email from mobile devices
quantified_operational_impact: About 12 open corrective actions at any time
quantified_regulatory_impact: Late corrective action responses lower supplier ratings

business_process: Finance: invoicing, collections, and cost accounting
description: Invoice shipments; collect payments; job costing; month-end close
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow, not time, drives this process: about $960,000 of invoicing per production day is delayed
manual_workaround: Invoice from shipping records after ERP returns; credit line for timing gaps
quantified_operational_impact: About 260 invoices a day; 5 days down delays about $4.8 million of invoicing

description: Weekly payroll; onboarding; terminations (which also trigger enclave account removal); time clocks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs weekly for production staff; termination notices must still reach IT the same day
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider; paper time sheets; phone termination notices to the Security Manager
quantified_regulatory_impact: Wage payment rules; late terminations leave enclave access open

business_process: Corporate email, collaboration, and office work
description: Commercial email, sales and commercial customer contact, corporate files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Commercial customer quotes and schedules move by email; CUI is not on these systems
manual_workaround: Mobile phones; enclave email for defense customers
dependent_third_parties: Commercial productivity SaaS provider; internet service providers
